oneLine: Vinir Engineering files DRHP with SEBI to launch its IPO.

sources.title: Vinir Engineering files DRHP with SEBI to launch its IPO; check details

synopsis: Vinir Engineering has filed its draft red herring prospectus with the Securities and Exchange Board of India for an initial public offering. The IPO is a 100 per cent fresh issue of 7.10 crore equity shares, or up to 71,000,000 equity shares of face value Rs 2 each. The net proceeds will be used for the purchase of advanced forging and machining plant and machinery worth Rs 149.850 crore, working capital requirements of Rs 35 crore, and for funding inorganic growth through unidentified acquisitions and general corporate purposes. GYR Capital Advisors is the book running lead manager, while KFin Technologies is the registrar to the issue. The proposed listing is on the BSE and NSE.
